One `/handoff` condenses dozens of turns into a one-page handoff docume"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"nt and continues in a clean new session — the old session stays untouched.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Long DSH sessions get slow, eat the context window, and start forgetting. DSH ships compaction and f"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ork, but
nothing that says *remember what matters, then start fresh*. This plugin is that missing st"},{"id":"p5s3","text":", but
nothing that says *remember what matters, then start fresh*. This plugin is that missing step."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"When the context window or session size crosses your threshold it **asks first**. On confirm, it wri"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"tes a
handoff document — **goal / approach / done / files / next steps / open questions** — creates "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"a new session in
the same workspace, injects the document as its first message, and opens it. The ne"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"w session already knows the
job; you don't re-explain anything."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How it differs from compaction and fork"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| | `/compact` | fork | this plugin |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Origin session | compacted in place | kept | **kept as-is**, linked back from its title |
| Load o"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"n the new session | same session | **full history copied** | **one page of handoff notes** |
| Who c"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ontinues | yourself | yourself | **a fresh session with a clean context** |
| When it switches | aut"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"omatically at the threshold | manually | **asks first at the threshold**, or fully automatic |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Compaction repacks the old baggage, fork copies it. This plugin writes the baggage down as a one-pag"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"e brief
and travels light."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Manual** — `/handoff [<N>|all]`; no argument uses the configured `turns` (default 50 user messag"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"es)
- **Automatic** — three policies: *replace* (before native compaction) / *hybrid* (when the sess"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ion gets heavy) /
*native* (never switch automatically)
- **Asks first** — confirm popup by default;"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" `notify` / `auto` modes available. After you dismiss a suggestion,
the trigger level must grow by a"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"nother 50% before asking again
- **Health row** — a persistent "context xx% | session xxMB | ~N turn"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"s left" line above the composer
- **Clean handoff** — new session inherits workspace, model route an"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"d agent preset (system prompt / tools / skills),
with none of the old context
- **Structured documen"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"t** — persisted to disk as well; browse past handoffs from the settings panel
- **Auto-open** — the "},{"id":"p12s9","text":"client half waits for the child session and navigates to it (once per child, no re-jumps on replay)
"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"- **Decision log** — every decision (action + reason) is recorded and viewable in settings
- **Zero "},{"id":"p12s11","text":"core changes** — a single `dsh.bundle.patch` row; only public host services are used"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Requires DSH desktop or CLI with Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Tested on: `0.1.0-rc.5`–`rc.8`, `0.1.1-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The plugin is a standard DSH bundle: put it into the `node_modules` of **the profile you are using**"},{"id":"p16s2","text":", then
register it there. the ne"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"w session **auto-opens**; the origin session stays intact and is linked back."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"> ⚠️ **Privacy**: the recent conversation text (user + assistant messages in the requested window) i"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"s sent

Full profile patch:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Without `provider`/`model`, the current session's latest logged model route is used."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Host half** (`index.mjs` + `lib/*.mjs`, plain ESM): public services only — `commands` (`/handoff"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"`),
`llm`, `agents` (`ctx.agents.create` — session **and** agent together, inheriting the origin's c"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"wd /
model route / agent preset via `agentPresets.mount`), `workspaceRegistry.attachSession`,
`sessi"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"onTitle.rename`, `userQuestions`. Automatic handoff hooks `agent/pre-step` (step boundary = safe poi"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"nt).
The client half reads health, edits config and triggers manual handoffs over Typert RPC.
- **Cl"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"ient half** (`src/client/` → `scripts/build-client.mjs` → `lib/client.js`): health row, settings pan"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"el
and handoff card; a `handoff` conversation node auto-opens the child session.
- **Black box**: ev"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"ery handoff writes stages and outcomes to
`<DSH_HOME>/session-handoff-docs/handoff-trace.jsonl` (lon"},{"id":"p32s9","text":"g text redacted, rotates at 5 MiB)."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- Supports DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` through `rc.8`, `0.1.1-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.1` / `rc.2`
(v"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"erified on 0.2.1-rc.2 on 2026-10-20: plugin load, health row, settings panel and stats RPC all work)"},{"id":"p34s3","text":".
DSH `0.1.2-alpha.1` split the conversation UI/service and needs a separate client-side migration.
"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"- `session.snapshotEvents()` is marked `@deprecated` by the host (it still uses it internally); a fu"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"ture
kernel may need a different read entry point.
- Chain state (which handoff in the chain, "alrea"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"dy handed off") is **in-memory only**; after a restart it is
recovered from the marker on the old se"},{"id":"p34s7","text":"ssion's title, so the chain index degrades to 1 (display only).
- A failed automatic handoff is **no"},{"id":"p34s8","text":"t retried automatically**; use the manual "hand off" button instead.
- Auto-open relies on client-si"},{"id":"p34s9","text":"de polling; verify edge timing on your DSH version."}],"truncated":true}
